name: reconcile-system-anchor
body: source: holistic-review feedback — plan coverage rule requires every implemented-by FQN to be touched by a plan task; the system node anchored to `apg.main` which no task modifies, while the plan's phase-02 task-4 edits `apg.print_help` (src/main.rs:537-585, carries the `apg project <sub>` help text). inconsistency: implemented-by edge pointed at code the plan never touches → verify gate refuse. resolution: repointed `solution.system.apg-cli` implemented-by from `apg.main` to `apg.print_help` — the function the help-text task actually modifies, so coverage is legitimate (a fake "modify apg.main" task would be nonsense) [with user].
